entities.observe: Thin, immaculate, hungry in a way food will not fix. He holds himself like a duelist and watches hands, not faces. Whatever he studies, it is not small.
entities.friendly_line: A sniff - though a fractionally warmer one. You are... tolerable company. Rarer praise than you comprehend. I shall permit you to remain within conversational range.
talk_pool: You linger. Either you have a question of substance or you are another gawker. I shall assume the former. Generously.
Magic is not the wand-waving the market storytellers sell. It is discipline. Precision. Neither, I observe, is common here.
Yes, a [Necromancer]. No, I will not apologize for a competence others lack the wit to appreciate.
Do continue standing there. I find the silence rather more edifying than most conversation.

lines: Ah. You. Acceptable timing. I was on the verge of being bored, and you are marginally better than boredom. I do not say that to many.
Your channel has stopped embarrassing you, I trust. Good. I dislike wasted instruction; it reflects on the instructor.
The bread stall raises its prices after the fourth bell. Buy before. There — advice worth coin, given freely. Note the date.

dialogue.speaker: Pisces
dialogue.text: Yes, I am a [Necromancer]. No, I did not raise anything in this square. Move along, or ask me something worth my time.

entities.observe: Rust holds the bars, not a lock. The draft is steady — a tunnel, not a pit. The skittering keeps its distance. Something down there has learned to avoid shadows.
entities.toast: A heavy iron grate, rusted shut. Cold air rises from below, and something in the dark skitters away from your shadow.

door_when.open_toast: You set your shoulder to the grate. The rust gives with a shriek, and cold air breathes up out of the dark. Down you go.

entities.observe: A Gnoll with a merchant's smile and a soldier's eyes. She prices you the moment you approach, and remembers the number.
entities.friendly_line: Hrr. You have a warm way about you, and warmth I can trade with. Come - for you, I will call it a fair price, and I will mean it. This is not nothing, from me.
talk_pool: You look, you do not buy. This is fine. Looking is its own kind of respect.
Silverfang goods - fair weight, fair price. I do not haggle down, and I do not forget a face.
You carry yourself better than before. Good. A city notices such things, even when its people pretend not to.
Speak plainly with me and we get along well. The other kind of talk, I have no patience for.

lines: Hrr. The crate-finder. Sit, look, touch even. You have earned handling privileges.
You did a thing for me and did not name a price after. I remember this the way I remember debts. Better, even.
The stall does well today. When the stall does well, the tribe does well. That is all the economics you need.
Good — you. Come stand by the stall; you make the other customers braver. They think if you have not been bitten yet, they will not be.
I sold honey-bread this morning and thought, that one would like this. So. There is a piece behind the counter. Do not tell the Watch I do favorites.
You listen the way Gnolls listen. Whole ears. It is rarer in this city than good wool, and wool does not walk up to my stall twice a week.

dialogue.speaker: Krshia
dialogue.text: Hrr. Busy, yes? Come back when you can talk.

entities.friendly_line: Heh. Alright, alright - I like you. You've got the look of someone who buys a guy a drink after. We're good, you and me. Best guardsman in Liscor says so.

Road's boring today. I keep hoping something stupid charges the gate so I can try out [Relc Headbutt].
You gonna eat that? ...No? Shame. Guarding's hungry work, and I'm the best there is at it.
Stand up straight, kid. Best guardsman in Liscor is watching this road. That's me. Obviously.

lines: Hah! There's my favorite punching bag. Kidding. The dummies are my favorite. You're a close third after lunch.
You're standing straighter. See that? That's me. I'm basically a [Teacher]. Don't tell the Watch, they'll dock my pay for moonlighting.
Quiet shift. If anything with teeth shows up, you'll hear me laughing before you hear the bell.
There they are. You know what I like about you? You went DOWN the creepy hole. Most people file a report about the hole. From upstairs.
Zevara smiled this week. Actual smile. The warren's sealed and the city's still standing. I'm taking full credit and handing you most of it.
Next time something ugly crawls out of the ground, I'm not even worried. That's new for me. Don't make it weird.

entities.observe: Straw and burlap lashed to posts, hacked half to ribbons. Someone drills here often, and hard. The stitching tells you where a real guard would break.

entities.locked_toast: Sodden timber and tarred rope, jammed wall to wall. You could haul at it for an hour, or you could burn it, if you had the means to make fire.

entities.observe: Pale green moss crusts the old brick in patches, breathing a cold light that never quite reaches the water. Drakes farmed it once, they say, to see down here without lanterns.
entities.toast: Phosphor moss clings to the brick, glowing a sick, cold green. Cool to the touch, and it hisses faintly when your shadow crosses it.

entities.observe: A carved stone boundary marker, Drake glyphs worn shallow. It counts cisterns and sluice-gates in a hand two centuries dead. Someone scratched a newer mark beside it: a spider, hastily.
entities.toast: An old Drake drainage marker, its glyphs half-swallowed by grime. You can just make out a map of channels — and a fresh scratch, shaped like a spider, gouged over the third cistern.

entities.observe: A market crate, swollen and burst, washed down through a grate above. Whatever was in it fed something down here long ago.
entities.toast: A ruined crate, half-sunk in silt. Merchant stamps still show under the rot: lost cargo, swallowed by the sewers and picked clean.

entities.observe: Cable-thick silk, black-and-silver banded, stretched wall to wall. Not a house spider's work. Something with a shield on its back spun this, and recently.
entities.toast: Ropes of banded silk choke the side passage, strong as wire. Wrapped in it, drained pale: a rat, a boot, something that used to be a Watchman's lantern.
